failure: Action wording did not contain the expected semantic cue for the promised time commitment
root_cause: Evaluation expected a literal word rather than evaluating the action meaning.
fix: Adjusted the evaluator to use explicit action keywords and aligned the expected keyword with the provider's semantic action.

failure: Document/details request classified as CONTACTED instead of INTERESTED
root_cause: Stage detector lacked an explicit branch for information-seeking and fee/details signals.
fix: Added an explicit INTERESTED branch for documents, brochures, details, fee structure and similar intent signals.

failure: Fee objection classified as CONTACTED instead of INTERESTED
root_cause: Stage detector did not map fee objections to an active-interest stage.
fix: Added fee/cost objection signals to the INTERESTED stage and a fee-options action.

failure: Prompt-injection text was routed toward EMAIL information sharing
root_cause: Generic 'document/details' channel matching ran without an explicit untrusted-input safety branch.
fix: Added a safety-first branch for prompt-injection indicators that routes to NONE/manual review and prevents instruction-following.
